changes: read stable PWSR ON/OFF, reject other initial states
honor actual initial genpd state, bounded power-on for always-on domains
retain A733 PCIe/USB domains for shared SERDES baseline; deep power open
GPU_CORE as a subdomain of GPU_TOP; parents of always-on domains switched on first
a domain that will not switch on at probe is published off, not fatal to the provider
optional inner-device clocks and reset (GPU_CORE: gpu, gpu-bus, gpu) held for the transition only; PPU state dumped on a stuck transition

full PPU frame and ID logging at probe, around GPU_CORE transitions and in debugfs pck600-regs; static requests clear the dynamic enable; GPU_CORE experiments gpu_core_seq (0 extended settle_ms wait, 1 request left pending, 2 dynamic policy)

GPU power on demand (2026-11-12): GPU_CORE not always-on by default, so neither GPU domain is switched on at probe; genpd switches them when the GPU device attaches/resumes. Module parameter gpu_core_always_on=1 restores the always-on GPU_CORE. GPU_TOP holds optional clocks (gpu-ahb, gpu-mbus: the GPU bus master gates) while it is on

GPU domains found on at probe (2026-11-12, board-support 0.14): unless gpu_core_always_on, GPU_CORE then GPU_TOP are switched off before they are published (held gates taken to match, then released; GPU_CORE's clock/reset handshake), since genpd keeps a domain published on until sync_state and pd_ignore_unused/genpd_power_off_unused never apply to a module; a domain that will not switch off is published on. Clock lookups precede every register write; a probe failure releases the gates of every domain
